segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSE study guide
Electricity is used daily
But if we do not follow proper safety then it can be very dangerous
So we get shock, burns, fires from electrical accidents to even photo accidents
So in today's video we will talk about 10 important electrical safety rules that every worker should know
So let's start the video
Rule number one is always de-energize equipment before working
Means any electrical inspection, repair or maintenance work before starting
The power supply of equipment is completely closed and it is very important to isolate
And always follow proper lockout tagout i.e. lot of procedures
This reduces the risk of accidental power on when a worker is working
Remember it is very dangerous to work on live equipment
Rule number two is to use proper PPE
It is very important to wear proper PPE during electrical work
Like insulated gloves, safety shoes, arc flash clothing, helmet and eye protections
PPE protects you from serious injuries
So never ignore PPE
Rule number three is never touch live electrical parts
Never assume that the circuit is safe
Always consider the electrical circuit as live
Until it is confirmed with proper testing that it is safe
Use the approved equipment before touching any electrical part
A small mistake can cause a big accident
Rule number four is to inspect tools and cables before use
Before starting the work, inspect electrical tools and cables
Check if there is any insulation damage, exposed wire, loose plug or broken cable
If the equipment is damaged, do not use it
Immediately report and replace it
Rule number five is to keep water away from electrical equipment
The combination of water and electricity is very dangerous
Weight hands or weight surface increases the risk of electric shock
So always operate the switches or machinery with dry hands
And avoid using electrical tools in the weight area
Rule number six is to use correct rated equipment and fuses
Never overload circuits or extension boards
Always use correct voltage and current rating devices
Fuses or breakers
Wrong rating can cause overheating and electrical fire
Rule number seven is to maintain safe distance from high voltage areas
It is very important to maintain safe distance from high voltage areas
Transformers, substations, overhead power lines and high voltage panels
Do not go without authorization
Always follow warning signs and barricades
Rule number eight is to ensure proper grounding and earthing
Proper grounding or earthing or electrical fault provides protection
If the grounding is not proper, then the electric current can pass through the body
So it is very important to inspect the grounding system regularly
Rule number nine is only trained persons should perform electrical work
Electrical work should only be done by trained and authorized persons
And trained workers should never attend electrical repairs or panel openings
It can be very dangerous to joke with electricity
Rule number ten is to report electrical hazards immediately
If you see spark, burning spales, exposed wires, overheating equipment or frequently tripping breakers
Then report immediately
Ignoring electrical hazards can be a major accident in the future
So friends, these were the 10 essential electrical safety rules
It is very important to follow in every workplace
Safety is not only a person's responsibility, but it is a responsibility of all of us
If you found this video helpful, then like and share the video
And don't forget to subscribe EHS's study guide channel
That's all for today, see you in the next video with a new topic
Till then take care, bye-bye
